# teams_meeting_broadcast_configuration (Resource)

Manages the MeetingBroadcastConfiguration configuration via Set-CsTeamsMeetingBroadcastConfiguration.

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `sdn_api_template_url` (String) Maps to the -SdnApiTemplateUrl parameter.
- `sdn_api_token` (String) Maps to the -SdnApiToken parameter.
- `sdn_license_id` (String) Maps to the -SdnLicenseId parameter.
- `sdn_provider_name` (String) Maps to the -SdnProviderName parameter.
- `sdn_runtime_configuration` (String) Maps to the -SdnRuntimeConfiguration parameter.
- `support_url` (String) Maps to the -SupportURL parameter.
